5. Compatibility and saves

Emulation depends on device performance, formats, core implementation, required system files and settings. We do not guarantee that every game runs or that graphics, audio, online play, saves or future versions remain fully compatible. Save states depend on core support. Loading a state replaces current unsaved progress.

Back up important files. Removing a game generally preserves separate Saves files but can delete homebrew data in the imported folder. Clearing cache, deleting saves and deleting the app have different effects; see the deletion explanation. Offload App differs from Delete App. Core updates, restored backups or different imported versions may make older saves unusable.

6. Third-party services

Game Emulator includes Google advertising on startup loading screens, non-game pages and explicit game exits, subject to loading, consent and frequency limits. Ads do not appear during gameplay. You can close fullscreen ads using the controls provided by Google. Ad clicks may open external content governed by its provider’s terms. See the Advertising privacy explanation.

Netplay, remote updates, achievements, cloud sync, AI / screen translation, system file providers and sharing recipients are operated by their respective providers. Separate terms, permissions, fees and availability may apply. Game Emulator cannot promise control or continued availability of third-party services or guarantee all external content. Online features may incur network-provider charges.
